# A file's removals settle: a truncate and a deallocate each leave a marker,
# the settle at pick=128 drops only the truncate's, the one after the delete
# at pick=255 drops the rest, and the reads and the fill between check the
# answers of a file with markers settled and not. Settling is not persisted,
# but this sequence crashes nowhere, so the markers stay dropped.
write s=1 f=1 len=32 b=97
truncate s=1 f=1 off=8
write s=1 f=1 off=8 len=8 b=120
deallocate s=1 f=1 off=16 len=4
read s=1 f=1 len=64
settle s=1 f=1 pick=128
fill s=1 f=1 off=24 len=8 b=200
read s=1 f=1 len=64
delete s=1 f=1
settle s=1 f=1 pick=255
read s=1 f=1 len=64
